sense: how big is the baby? — so big!

terms.gloss: so big! (of a boy; of a girl), with the arms spread wide
evidence: Ter. Ad. 4.2.24, in Lewis & Short’s numbering (s.v. tantillus): puerum tantillum, a boy this little, with a gesture
terms.comment: The answer to Quantus est …?, with the arms raised: the classical pair quantus … tantus. No ancient form of the game is known.

phrases.latin: Haecine meae sunt fīliae? quantae ē quantillīs jam sunt factae.
phrases.english: Are these my daughters? How big they’ve grown, from such little things!
How big is Theo? — Sooo big!

sources: Lewis & Short: tantus · Lewis & Short: tantillus · Lewis & Short: quantillus
Plautus checked against Leo’s text (1896) at Gadsden Classics; Lewis & Short cites the lines as Poen. 5.3.47.
